providers.description: Aletheia's own Python modules, run locally or in CI
GitHub Actions in this repo executing on schedule or push
GitHub REST API via aletheia.gh (FLEET_TOKEN / GITHUB_TOKEN)
ChatGPT app (subscription): voice/text interface + GitHub connector writes
Claude Code sessions (subscription): builds and maintains Aletheia and the fleet

capabilities.description: Resolve the fleet registry: repos, roles, agents, watch lists, front-door grants
capabilities.caller: aletheia.pulse, aletheia.act, aletheia.intercom, CLI

capabilities.description: Observe every fleet repo: commits, workflows, state files, vitals, transitions, alerts
capabilities.caller: pulse.yml (6-hourly) and CLI
capabilities.verification: pulse names every registry repo or records why not
capabilities.notes: verified live on main 2026-08-25: reads commits, workflow outcomes, state files and vitals for every PUBLIC fleet repo using the default GITHUB_TOKEN. Only private repos need the FLEET_TOKEN secret — today that is etsy_maker alone, which the pulse records honestly as a 404 rather than omitting.

capabilities.description: Compose the morning digest with day-over-day deltas and deliver via rolling issue
capabilities.caller: brief.yml (daily) and CLI

capabilities.description: Notice health transitions; open/comment/close the rolling fleet-alert issue
capabilities.caller: pulse.yml after each pulse

capabilities.description: Durable append-only memory: decisions, events, actions, notes
capabilities.caller: every capability that acts; CLI for operator notes

capabilities.description: Search the memory by term, kind, or recency
capabilities.caller: CLI; brief.compose (last-24h section)

capabilities.description: Goals as tracked data: open plans, steps with states, journaled lifecycle
capabilities.caller: CLI, intercom plan_* commands; surfaced by pulse/brief/wall

capabilities.description: Durable task engine: lifecycle, dependencies, retries surviving restarts
capabilities.caller: CLI (aletheia.tasks); intercom wiring is the next milestone

capabilities.description: Run a fleet repo's workflow through its front door
capabilities.caller: aletheia.act CLI and intercom 'dispatch' commands
capabilities.notes: gated by front_door in config/fleet.json — default grants only Aletheia's own workflows

capabilities.description: File an issue on a fleet repo
capabilities.caller: aletheia.act CLI and intercom 'issue' commands

capabilities.description: Record a ruling on a ChatGPT suggestion (doing/not_doing/later/in_progress/done)
capabilities.caller: CLI; intercom 'rule' commands

capabilities.description: Operator speaks to ChatGPT (voice/text, no API keys); commands relayed as JSON, executed through registry gates, receipts written back
capabilities.caller: intercom.yml on exchange/commands pushes (cloud kinds) + the Core's sync loop on the PC (LOCAL_KINDS: browse_read, browse_shot) — static partition, one executor per command
capabilities.verification: every command gets a committed .result.json receipt
capabilities.notes: executor built and tested (15 command kinds incl. halt/resume/approve/deny/remember/tasks); needs the operator to create the ChatGPT Project per exchange/INTERCOM.md

capabilities.description: Hand a durable task to an AI worker (Claude builds; ChatGPT reviews/authors) and track it
capabilities.caller: director in pulse.yml: files approval-gated work orders for READY assigned tasks
capabilities.notes: dispatch half is built+tested; EXPERIMENTAL until the first live round-trip (worker completes a work order with evidence). Worker wake-up is still each app's own scheduled tasks.

capabilities.description: Operate the Windows PC: observe, open apps, click, type (accessibility-first)
capabilities.caller: aletheia.computer.execute — reachable through the local Core's POST /api/computer and the CLI; every run needs an approval bound to that exact plan
capabilities.verification: policy layer verified hermetically (41 tests, injected backend): exact-plan approval binding by sha256, single-use claim, halt checked before setup and every step, screen coordinates refused, plan validated before any desktop access
capabilities.notes: EXPERIMENTAL, not AVAILABLE: the Windows UI Automation backend has never executed on Windows — no reviewer here has that platform. scripts/phase7_accept_notepad.ps1 is the acceptance run that decides whether this becomes AVAILABLE or gets repaired.

capabilities.description: Place and hold a phone conversation on the operator's behalf (identifies itself as Aletheia)
capabilities.caller: ticket — Phone V0 (Playbook §17): desktop call app + virtual audio + ChatGPT Voice, local PC only

capabilities.description: Room voice: local wake word ('Thea'), spoken requests into the same Core
capabilities.caller: ticket — Phase 10 (Playbook §124)

capabilities.description: Check the inbox: unread senders + subjects, spoken back ('Thea, check my email')
capabilities.caller: aletheia.mail.check_unread via intercom kind email_check (LOCAL — runs on the PC) and voice
capabilities.verification: tests/test_mail.py TestCheckAndVoice — speakable summary, empty inbox honest, IMAP opened readonly so checking never marks messages read
capabilities.notes: Same configuration as email.send; headers only, bodies are never fetched in v0.

capabilities.description: Draft and send email with approval gate
capabilities.caller: aletheia.mail.send_approved — the Core delivers every APPROVED draft each sync tick; drafts come from voice ('Thea, email X that ...'), the intercom kind email_draft, or the Command Center
capabilities.verification: tests/test_mail.py: approval bound to a sha256 of the exact draft (edited-after-approval refused), operator_always per send, sent exactly once, DENIED retires, transport failure retries, unknown recipient refused rather than guessed, state/mail gitignored (privacy — public repo)
capabilities.notes: NEEDS_CONFIGURATION: set ALETHEIA_MAIL_ADDRESS + ALETHEIA_MAIL_PASSWORD (an app password) on the PC, or ~/.aletheia/mail.json. Gmail-shaped defaults; hosts overridable.

capabilities.description: Read availability, reason about work hours and buffers
capabilities.caller: ticket — Phase 14 (Playbook §128)

capabilities.description: Unified device layer (Home Assistant or equivalent): lights, scenes, media
capabilities.caller: ticket — Phase 18 (Playbook §132)

capabilities.description: The kill switch: halt suspends every acting capability until an operator resume
capabilities.caller: intercom halt/resume commands, CLI; enforced in act + intercom + director

capabilities.description: Durable approval objects: requested as issues or by workers, decided by owner comment or by voice
capabilities.caller: director (delegate gate), approvals.yml on owner comments, intercom approve/deny, CLI

capabilities.description: Deterministic goal-to-tasks compiler with evidence-gated completion (a step is done only when its task completed WITH evidence)
capabilities.caller: pulse.yml every run; CLI

capabilities.description: Structured memory with provenance (identity/preferences/people/organizations); corrections overwrite but record what they replaced
capabilities.caller: intercom remember commands, CLI, Claude sessions

capabilities.description: Recall a memory and answer 'why do you think that' from provenance
capabilities.caller: CLI; ChatGPT reads memory/ raw for reference resolution

capabilities.description: The local Core V0: persistent service on the operator's PC — internal API (/api/*), the wall at /, Command Center at /command.html; loopback-only until authentication exists
capabilities.caller: operator runs `python -m aletheia.core` on the Windows PC; Command Center + wall are its clients
capabilities.verification: GET /api/status; 7 tests in test_core.py incl. live HTTP round-trips
capabilities.notes: code built and tested in CI; NEEDS_CONFIGURATION = the operator starting it on the PC

capabilities.description: The Core keeps the repo fresh: pull commands, execute PC-only kinds, push receipts + journal
capabilities.caller: aletheia.core.start_sync_loop — on by default when `python -m aletheia.core` runs inside a cloned repo; degrades honestly (loop OFF, /api/sync says why) outside one
capabilities.verification: tests/test_sync.py + tests/test_core_sync.py drive the full round trip against a real local bare repo, including push races, rebase-conflict abort, receipt idempotency, and a dead remote
capabilities.notes: NEEDS_CONFIGURATION until the Core runs on the PC — same single blocker as core.serve. Uses the operator's own git credentials; a push that cannot authenticate is journaled, never worked around.

capabilities.description: Aletheia stays on: relaunch the Core on crash, restart it onto newly merged code, start at Windows logon
capabilities.caller: start-aletheia.bat and bootstrap.ps1 run `python -m aletheia.supervisor`; `supervisor install` registers the hidden at-logon Scheduled Task
capabilities.verification: tests/test_supervisor.py (backoff doubles and caps, self-update restarts immediately and resets backoff, Ctrl+C stops, install refuses honestly off Windows) + tests/test_core_sync.py SelfUpdateCase (code commit fires restart against a real repo, state-only commit does not)
capabilities.notes: NEEDS_CONFIGURATION until it runs on the PC. Self-update chain: merge to main -> Core's sync pull sees CODE_PATHS changed -> exits RESTART_EXIT_CODE -> supervisor relaunches on the new code, within about one sync beat.

capabilities.description: Talk to the page itself: the wall/Command Center hear 'Thea, ...' and speak the answer — no side app
capabilities.caller: interface/voice.js (Web Speech API in the operator's browser) -> POST /api/voice -> voice.interpret -> the same run_command gates as every channel
capabilities.verification: tests/test_voice.py: 15 tests — wake word, halt/resume, spoken URLs ('example dot com'), approve refuses to guess between two pending, unrecognized speech becomes a journaled note (never a guessed action), endpoint round trip on a live Core
capabilities.notes: NEEDS_CONFIGURATION until the Core runs on the PC and the operator clicks the mic indicator once (browser permission). Ears/mouth are the browser's own (Chrome/Edge); the interpreter is deterministic on purpose - unmatched speech is journaled and said so, never guessed (§104). ChatGPT Voice remains the away-from-home channel.

capabilities.description: Observe any web page through the authorized browser profile: title, visible text, links, screenshots
capabilities.caller: aletheia.browse CLI (read/shot); intercom kinds browse_read/browse_shot via the Core's sync loop; the Command Center's /api/command
capabilities.verification: 12 hermetic tests in tests/test_browse.py drive a real Chromium against a loopback fixture site
capabilities.notes: requires the optional playwright dependency; browse.available() reports honestly and callers degrade rather than crash

capabilities.description: Act on a web page — click, type, select, submit — inside the operator's own authenticated session
capabilities.caller: aletheia.browse.interact — refuses without an APPROVED approval, before the browser opens
capabilities.verification: tested end to end: an approved run fills a form, selects an option and submits it; unapproved, denied, malformed and halted runs are all refused
capabilities.notes: never bypasses authentication: the operator signs in once via 'python -m aletheia.browse login <url>' into a dedicated persistent profile (cache/browser-profile, gitignored). Permission to read a page is never permission to press its buttons (§61).

agents.description: Builds and maintains Aletheia and the fleet; the only worker that edits code
agents.limitations: woken by sessions/scheduled tasks, not yet by Aletheia itself

agents.description: Thea's voice and advisor; relays operator commands, reviews, researches
